skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply project management principles to design and evaluate investment projects.
Analyze financial aspects of investment projects, including cost-benefit analysis and financial modeling.
Understand legal and regulatory frameworks relevant to investment projects.
Conduct market analysis to assess investment opportunities and project feasibility.
Evaluate technical aspects of investment projects, including technology selection and resource allocation.
Assess the economic and social impacts of investment projects.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate and choose optimal investment options.
Work effectively in teams and collaborate on project tasks.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and manage personal study.
Present project findings and analyses effectively to stakeholders.
